## Required R1/R2 continuation before R3

The bounded required local journeys now pass. The populated general requester flow distinguishes a submitted package from approval and requested from accepted dates, exposes its actual server next action, retains fields after a stale version and refresh, and recovers lost creation/submission replies with identical payload/key and one effect. A real local SQL service archive removes edit scope while keeping the same account/general capabilities; restoring it shows the saved server draft rather than the former private inputs. The separate member/head/guest first-work, scoped contacts, isolated practice and all five 320px primary-target checks pass again. The guest preview uses its explicit shared-record link; the general /shared index remains unconnected and is not claimed delivered.

RecordScope now checks current task/deliverable/request/FIN-review/FIN-intake/publicity/department-review reads on focus and every 30 seconds, inside the existing shell so navigation remains available. Pending checks pause mounted forms; connection failures hide/pause them and retain memory with a Check record access again control. A confirmed denied read clears that record's registered draft entries and unmounts its page. Read/manager/detail scope changes and same-state action-scope downgrades clear the affected drafts. Workflow-state changes alone retain uncertain commands: a successful submission can change action availability before its reply arrives. Server commands independently reauthorize every retry. This presentation check is not a new authorization engine or a real-JWT test.

The seven existing request/form/finance/decision/review/handoff/schedule memory providers register only in-memory maps. Clearing uses exact record-key segments (plus the existing term+record reviewer key), preserves unrelated records, and rotates the map snapshot so a late callback from a revoked form cannot repopulate the active store. Identity/term/capability changes still reset the existing provider tree. No private localStorage/sessionStorage/cache was added. Direct request refresh also observes confirmed scope changes. Task/deliverable local forms are cleared by the scoped page remount; their existing discard protection and business commands remain authoritative.
